candidates.description: This feature detects the letter sequence "um" occurring within various words and contexts.
This vector represents actions or processes involving physical or abstract increase, buildup, or structural manipulation.
This vector activates for tokens sharing the Latin root prefix 'di-' or 'div-', frequently associated with divergence, difference, or division.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to words and subwords related to weather phenomena, tropical climates, and geographic regions.
This vector represents letter sequences and sub-word tokens containing the letters "ol" or "sol".
This feature activates strongly on tokens beginning with the Spanish, French, or English prefix or root sequence "ent-" or "cent-".
This vector represents words related to shape, form, and structural categorization across multiple languages.
This vector represents common adjectives and nouns in Romance languages, particularly Italian and French.
This vector represents sub-word morphological suffixes and prepositional roots ending in dental or nasal consonant clusters.
This feature vector activates strongly on Italian nouns related to systematic processes, structures, and organized concepts.
